summary: 搭建和调试 Phaser 4（及 Phaser 3.90）游戏：游戏配置、场景生命周期、加载器、场景切换和 3 到 4 的迁移。 Sets up and debugs Phaser 4 games (and pinned Phaser 3.90): Game config, Scene lifecycle, the loader, scene transitions and Phaser 3 to 4 migration. Use when code imports phaser, or on a black screen, assets undefined in create, or a HUD scene behind the game. Not for colliders (`phaser-arcade-physics`), HUD layout (`game-ui-ux`) or PixiJS (`pixijs-rendering`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill phaser-core，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use when code imports phaser, or on a black screen, assets undefined in create, or a HUD scene behind the game.
Workflow: Read the installed major; Keep rules out of scenes; Create one game from a config; One `Scene` subclass per screen.

需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：phaser-arcade-physics 用 gene_gdsk_phaser_arcade_physics_v1，game-ui-ux 用 gene_gdsk_game_ui_ux_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
